{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-}
{-# LANGUAGE DeriveGeneric #-}

module InferenceServer where

import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map
import Data.Map.Strict (Map)
import Data.IORef
import Data.Hashable
import GHC.Generics (Generic)
import Data.Text (Text)
import qualified Data.Text as T
import Data.Word (Word64)
import Data.Bits (xor, shiftL, shiftR)
import Control.Concurrent.MVar
import Control.Monad (when, unless)
import Data.Time.Clock (UTCTime, getCurrentTime, diffUTCTime)

-- Model inference result type
data InferenceResult = InferenceResult
  { prediction :: [Double]
  , confidence :: Double
  , modelVersion :: Text
  } deriving (Show, Eq, Generic)

-- Tenant context for multi-tenant isolation
data TenantContext = TenantContext
  { tenantId :: Text
  , modelId :: Text
  , permissions :: [Text]
  , quotaRemaining :: Int
  } deriving (Show, Eq, Generic)

-- Cache entry with metadata
data CacheEntry = CacheEntry
  { cachedResult :: InferenceResult
  , cachedAt :: UTCTime
  , ownerTenant :: Text
  , accessLevel :: Text
  } deriving (Show, Eq)

-- Feature vector for inference
data FeatureVector = FeatureVector
  { features :: [Double]
  , featureDim :: Int
  , normalize :: Bool
  } deriving (Show, Eq, Generic)

-- The inference cache with tenant isolation
data InferenceCache = InferenceCache
  { cacheStore :: MVar (Map Word64 CacheEntry)
  , maxEntries :: Int
  , ttlSeconds :: Double
  }

-- Initialize a new cache
newInferenceCache :: Int -> Double -> IO InferenceCache
newInferenceCache maxSize ttl = do
  store <- newMVar Map.empty
  return $ InferenceCache store maxSize ttl

-- Compute cache key from tenant context and feature vector
-- Uses FNV-1a inspired hashing for cache key derivation
computeCacheKey :: TenantContext -> FeatureVector -> Word64
computeCacheKey ctx fv =
  let tenantHash = hashTenantScope ctx
      featureHash = hashFeatures (features fv)
      -- Combine tenant scope with feature hash for isolation
      combined = mixHashes tenantHash featureHash
  in combined

-- Hash the tenant scope for cache partitioning
hashTenantScope :: TenantContext -> Word64
hashTenantScope ctx =
  let tid = T.unpack (tenantId ctx)
      mid = T.unpack (modelId ctx)
      -- Hash tenant identifier
      tHash = fnv1a (map (fromIntegral . fromEnum) tid)
      -- Hash model identifier  
      mHash = fnv1a (map (fromIntegral . fromEnum) mid)
  in tHash `xor` mHash

-- FNV-1a hash implementation
fnv1a :: [Word64] -> Word64
fnv1a = foldl step 14695981039346656037
  where
    step hash byte = (hash `xor` byte) * 1099511628211

-- Hash feature vector values
hashFeatures :: [Double] -> Word64
hashFeatures fs =
  let quantized = map (\f -> round (f * 1000) :: Word64) fs
  in fnv1a quantized

-- Mix two hashes together
mixHashes :: Word64 -> Word64 -> Word64
mixHashes a b =
  let rotated = (a `shiftL` 32) `xor` (a `shiftR` 32)
  in rotated `xor` b

-- Validate tenant has access to cached entry
validateTenantAccess :: TenantContext -> CacheEntry -> Bool
validateTenantAccess ctx entry =
  let isOwner = tenantId ctx == ownerTenant entry
      isShared = accessLevel entry == "shared"
  in isOwner || isShared

-- Perform model inference (simulated)
runModelInference :: TenantContext -> FeatureVector -> IO InferenceResult
runModelInference ctx fv = do
  -- In production, this calls the actual ML model
  let dim = featureDim fv
      preds = replicate dim 0.5
  return $ InferenceResult preds 0.95 (modelId ctx)

-- Main inference endpoint with caching
cachedInference :: InferenceCache -> TenantContext -> FeatureVector -> IO InferenceResult
cachedInference cache ctx fv = do
  now <- getCurrentTime
  let key = computeCacheKey ctx fv
  
  -- Try cache lookup
  store <- readMVar (cacheStore cache)
  case Map.lookup key store of
    Just entry -> do
      let age = realToFrac (diffUTCTime now (cachedAt entry)) :: Double
      if age < ttlSeconds cache && validateTenantAccess ctx entry
        then return (cachedResult entry)
        else computeAndCache cache ctx fv key now
    Nothing -> computeAndCache cache ctx fv key now

-- Compute inference and store in cache
computeAndCache :: InferenceCache -> TenantContext -> FeatureVector -> Word64 -> UTCTime -> IO InferenceResult
computeAndCache cache ctx fv key now = do
  result <- runModelInference ctx fv
  let entry = CacheEntry result now (tenantId ctx) "private"
  modifyMVar_ (cacheStore cache) $ \store -> do
    let newStore = if Map.size store >= maxEntries cache
          then Map.insert key entry (Map.deleteMin store)
          else Map.insert key entry store
    return newStore
  return result

-- Batch inference with shared cache optimization
batchInference :: InferenceCache -> TenantContext -> [FeatureVector] -> IO [InferenceResult]
batchInference cache ctx vectors = mapM (cachedInference cache ctx) vectors

-- Admin endpoint to mark cache entries as shared across tenants
markShared :: InferenceCache -> TenantContext -> FeatureVector -> IO Bool
markShared cache ctx fv = do
  unless ("admin" `elem` permissions ctx) $ return ()
  let key = computeCacheKey ctx fv
  modifyMVar (cacheStore cache) $ \store ->
    case Map.lookup key store of
      Just entry ->
        let updated = entry { accessLevel = "shared" }
            newStore = Map.insert key updated store
        in return (newStore, True)
      Nothing -> return (store, False)
